_removedOnClinicalReview.Guillain-Barré Syndrome: PATIENT SAFETY. GBS is an acute, rapidly ascending neuromuscular emergency; IVIG for GBS is given inpatient with respiratory and autonomic monitoring. There is no home infusion pathway. Naming it on a home-infusion page risks routing an emergency toward the home. Chronic/relapsing disease is coded CIDP, which remains listed.
_removedOnClinicalReview.Immune Thrombocytopenia: ITP is hematology, not oncology, but there is no hematology row in CoreFlow’s seven specialties, so it had nowhere correct to sit and was rendering beside rituximab in the Oncology group, which reads as "we treat ITP with rituximab" (off-label).
_removedOnClinicalReview.Alpha-1 Antitrypsin Deficiency: Its only treatment is weekly IV alpha-1 augmentation, and no augmentation product exists anywhere in _data/therapies.json: not confirmed, not even flagged. The site would name a condition whose therapy it has no record of carrying, under a specialty that already renders empty.
